name: select
title: Select
description: shadcn/ui's base-nova select, fixed: The theme's shadow-md and shadow-lg are shadow-float, so its popup drops shadcn's ring, which doubled the shadow's hairline; its rows are 32px tall (min-h-8) with an 8px radius, as in every menu. On a phone (narrower than 640px) it opens as a sheet from the bottom, as the platform's action sheets do: across the screen over a scrim that closes it when tapped, a handle to swipe it down by, its options 44px tall, clear of the home indicator, and `sheetTitle` on top; it stays Base UI's popup, its roles, focus and keys. `sheet={false}` keeps it anchored. Its spacing on the 4px module (docs/grid.md). It pops in and out by the theme's motion-pop (in at 150ms on --ease-enter, out at 100ms on --ease-exit), not shadcn's 100ms on `ease`.
